title: Implement Migration Phase C — Full MCP
description: Implement Migration Phase C: agents use the SDK exclusively for ticket operations (claim, advance, rework, release, sync). Feature flags set all operations to `database` mode. The filesystem becomes read-only — the export (FORGEOS-BE072) runs periodically to keep filesystem in sync as a backup, but no agent writes to the filesystem for ticket state. WORK commits (code changes) remain git-based. The SDK no longer attempts filesystem fallback; failures are surfaced as errors.

Phase transition gate: zero filesystem writes detected for 72+ hours
Phase C entry and exit logged with timestamp and error rates
